mapper.select: SELECT id, product_id, seckill_price, stock_count, available_count, start_time, end_time, status, creator_id, seckill_name, per_limit, images, description, is_deleted, create_time, update_time FROM t_seckill_goods WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND start_time <= NOW() AND end_time >= NOW() ORDER BY start_time ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE t_seckill_goods SET available_count = available_count - 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0 AND available_count > 0
